messages:
Auditor (Grant): Hi team — we're missing evidence for the keystore control for Q1 2025. Need chain-of-custody + access logs for KMS/HSM ops covering 2025-01-01 -> 2025-03-31. Specifically: - KMS key rotation events (create/rotate/destroy) for keys used by hosted inference (key IDs acceptable) - HSM operator sessions and admin actions - S3/audit-retention lifecycle policy applied to those logs - A reproducible export playbook (so auditor can re-run locally)
Can you confirm scope, sample size, and ETA? Thanks.

Sam (eng-security): @Auditor (Grant) scope understood. We'll prepare a scoped export and a runnable playbook. Two quick clarifications: 1) Do you need full payloads (redacted) or just metadata + hashes? 2) Is a 90-day sample window acceptable if that accelerates delivery?

Auditor (Grant): metadata + hashes is fine. 90-day sample OK but it must include at least one rotation and one destroy event if those occurred in the quarter.

Lee (infra): Adding infra. Plan to: - sync s3 prefix: s3://redwood-audit/kms/2025/01-03/ - pull HSM admin events from hsm-audit-bucket - emit manifest.csv with checksums and an event timeline ETA: can stage a pre-signed export in ~36-48 hrs unless legal blocks.

Nina (support): FYI we had an internal incident on 2025-02-18 related to key rotation fallback logic — INC-2025-218. That likely contains the rotation events you need. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2025-218

Auditor (Grant): Please include that incident ID in the manifest and flag any expedited rotations.

Sam (eng-security): Will do. Draft repro playbook (prototype script below) — we'll provide a polished runnable artifact in the export bundle:

```
# repro-export.sh (prototype)
set -e
BUCKET="redwood-audit"
PREFIX="$1" # e.g. kms/2025/01-03/
OUT="/tmp/audit-export-$(date +%s).tar.gz"
aws s3 sync s3://$BUCKET/$PREFIX /tmp/audit-export --exclude "**/payloads/**"
cd /tmp/audit-export
jq -c '. as $entry | {path: $entry.path, sha256: ($entry.sha256)}' manifest/*.json > export-manifest.json
tar czf $OUT audit/ manifest.json
echo $OUT
```

Lee (infra): For HSM, internal helper (redacted for external):

```
hsmctl export --start 2025-01-01 --end 2025-03-31 --types admin,audit --out /tmp/hsm-audit.jsonl
jq -c '. | {ts: .ts, user: .user, action: .action, object: .object, session: .session_id, payload_hash: (sha256sum(.payload) | split(" ") | .[0]) }' /tmp/hsm-audit.jsonl > /tmp/hsm-export-metadata.jsonl
```

Sam (eng-security): Example redacted log lines we'll include in the manifest (fields: ts user action object rotation_id/session):

```
2025-02-18T03:14:22Z grant-deploy rotate-key kms-key-abc123 [rotation_id=rot-20250218-1] user=ops@redwood.com session=sz-98a7
2025-02-18T03:14:28Z hsm-admin destroy-key hsm-key-xy9 [request_id=req-9f8e] user=admin@security.com session=op-44b
```

Nina (support): ETA on the pre-signed bundle? Auditor needs a download URL that expires in 7 days.

Lee (infra): We'll stage to s3://redwood-audit-exports/1764252120-export.tar.gz and post a pre-signed URL. Job created job-1764252123. ETA ~36 hrs to upload and generate link.

deploy-bot: job-1764252123 status -> queued by lee_infra @ 2025-03-28T11:02:00Z

Sam (eng-security): For retention proof we'll include: - S3 lifecycle policy JSON and ARN - bucket policy statements - redacted console screenshot of lifecycle rule - an explanation of how logs are retained and archived to the compliance bucket

Auditor (Grant): Also need KMS key policy snapshots at rotation timestamps and confirmation whether KMS audit logs route to the same S3 bucket (or mapping if elsewhere).

Sam (eng-security): We'll include snapshots of kms:DescribeKey output at rotation times and a mapping table: key_id -> log_prefix -> bucket. If logs are routed to different buckets we'll include cross-references and reasoning.

Lee (infra): Note: HSM operator sessions are mirrored hourly to hsm-audit-bucket. For privacy we'll redact IP addresses but keep user IDs, timestamps, session IDs. We'll provide original vs redacted checksums so you can verify integrity.

Auditor (Grant): Redaction acceptable if you provide SHA256s for both original and redacted objects so we can verify consistency.

Sam (eng-security): We'll provide checksums.csv with columns: original_sha256, redacted_sha256, object_path, redaction_reason.

Nina (support): Legal sign-off: who owns approval to share these artifacts externally to auditors? @Sam (eng-security)

Sam (eng-security): I'll coordinate with Legal. Historically we run an auditor-only S3 delivery with a short-term pre-signed link and an NDA. I expect sign-off within 24 hrs; will confirm in this thread.

Lee (infra): For reproducibility I'll attach a read-only runbook link (auditor access once NDA signed): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/audit-export-v2 — the bundle will include the runbook and a sample manifest.csv showing event_type, key_id, ts, incident_id, object_path.

Auditor (Grant): Please embed a timeline CSV in the manifest: event_type, key_id, ts, related_incident_id, evidence_object_path. That makes mapping to controls straightforward.

Sam (eng-security): Confirmed — manifest schema will include those fields plus checksum columns.

Lee (infra): Update: export job started now. Will post pre-signed URL when upload completes. Current job id job-1764252123. Progress updates posted here.

Sam (eng-security): Action items recap:
- Lee: produce pre-signed export + HSM metadata, manifest + checksums (36-48 hrs)
- Sam: coordinate Legal and prepare retention/KMS policy artifacts
- Nina: add incident mapping for INC-2025-218
- Team: include reproducible script + runbook in export

Auditor (Grant): Thanks — please post the pre-signed URL and manifest file here when ready. :white_check_mark:

Lee (infra): Update: job in progress, upload ETA ~36 hrs. Will post link when available.

Sam (eng-security): Noted. I'll ping Legal and share status here once signed off.

Auditor (Grant): Acknowledged — will review artifacts when posted. Appreciate the quick coordination.
